t: This is Athlone House, a large Victorian house in Highgate beside Hampstead Heath. It was formerly known as Caen Wood Towers. Two owners are linked to it. Sir Robert Waley Cohen was a British industrialist and a prominent leader of Anglo-Jewry. Much later, the house was owned by Mikhail Fridman, a Ukrainian-born Russian-Israeli businessman who co-founded the Russian conglomerate Alfa-Group.
